title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
OSAP Students
Submit online OSAP application and all required supporting documentation online, or to Service Laurier by the following dates:
Deadlines to apply for OSAP:
Full-time
OSAP: 60 days prior to your study period end date
Part-time
OSAP: 40 days prior to your study period end date
Please note, we strongly encourage
students
to submit your applications and all required documents at least two
months before the start of
term
to allow time for processing and to give the
best chance of your funding being eligible for release at the start of classes.
More
Information Is available online:  students.wlu.ca/OSAP
OSAP will be sent directly to Laurier and you will be required to pay any outstanding term fees by the due date specified on the invoice. If you do not pay fees by the due date on your invoice, you will also be responsible for late fees applied to your account.
